name: glucose-biomodel-do
description: Search BioModels for a text query, annotate hits with HRA Uberon organ terms (synonym-match), and build the inverse organ->models index.

max_results.description: Max number of matching models to annotate.

catalog_step.doc: Search BioModels for a text query, annotate each hit with HRA Uberon organ terms via transparent synonym-matching over the model name, and build the inverse organ->models index.

_contract.summary: Search BioModels for a text query, annotate each hit with HRA Uberon organ terms via transparent synonym-matching over the model name, and build the inverse organ->models index.

outputs.biomodel_dos: One `biomodel_do` record per BioModels hit: `biomodel_id`, `name`, `organs` (list of `matched_organ` — organ slug + Uberon CURIE, one per HRA organ whose name/synonym matched), and `provenance` (annotation source/method).
outputs.organ_to_models: Inverse index: Uberon CURIE -> list of `biomodel_id`s annotated with that organ.

assumptions: Organ matching is transparent substring synonym-matching over the model name (`ORGAN_SYNONYMS`), not a learned classifier — a model with no matching synonym contributes no `matched_organ` and is absent from `organ_to_models`.

_contract.description: type(name, bases, dict, **kwds) -> a new type
